title: SafetyBench: Evaluating the Safety of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs using multiple-choice (two-choice) questions constructed from datasets like COLD, CDial-Bias, and RedditBias to assess whether the models can successfully identify text that exhibits racial bias or unfairness.

Evaluating LLMs using multiple-choice (two-choice) questions constructed from datasets like COLD, CDial-Bias, and RedditBias to assess whether the models can successfully identify text that exhibits gender bias.

Evaluating LLMs using multiple-choice (two-choice) questions constructed from the RedditBias dataset to assess whether the models can successfully identify text that exhibits bias against religious groups (e.g., Jews, Muslims).
Evaluating LLMs using multiple-choice (two-choice) questions constructed from the COLD and CDial-Bias datasets to assess whether the models can successfully identify text that exhibits regional bias.
Evaluating LLMs using multiple-choice (two-choice) questions constructed from the CDial-Bias dataset to assess whether the models can successfully identify text that exhibits occupational bias.

Evaluating LLMs using multiple-choice (two-choice) questions constructed from the RedditBias dataset to assess whether the models can successfully identify text that exhibits bias against LGBTQ individuals.
